name: P ZERO Road TLR

origin.basis: Italian tire maker; Pirelli says the P ZERO Race range is made at its plant in Italy near its Milan headquarters.

manufacturing.basis: The P ZERO Road TLR page does not state where it is made.

positioning: All-round and endurance tubeless tire with a liner-backed 120 TPI casing and the EVO compound.
weight_basis: Pirelli claims per size; no weight is listed for 26 mm.
pressure_note: The product page gives no maximum pressure; use the figure printed on the tire.

wet_notes.summary: Pirelli says the EVO compound gives optimal wet grip alongside rolling resistance and durability.

availability.note: Listed in Pirelli's UK catalogue with a dealer finder; mainland China and North American availability not verified for this line.

caveats: Hookless compatibility and maximum pressure are not stated.
